Sophia and Manuel Brown (hereinafter the Debtors) filed for bankruptcy on 04.15.2024. Records show that Sophia and Manuel Brown possess a decorative bowl filled with dried botanicals with a value of $120.00. A disclosure of assets by the Debtors reports a custom dress shirt made from Egyptian cotton with monogram cuffs with a current value of $190.00. The dishwasher with stainless steel tub and delayed start functionality currently owned by Sophia and Manuel carries a value of $1,720.00. The value of the wireless router with mesh network support and four LAN ports owned by the Browns has been calculated to be $1,630.00.
